blocks.title: Dissolution
blocks.text: Kisi solute (ghulne wali cheez) ko solvent (ghulane wale madde) mein ghulane ke process ko dissolution kehte hain.
Maana jata hai ke solution teen qadmon mein banta hai:

items: Solvent ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces ko kamzor kar ke solute ke liye jagah banana (solvent ka phailna).
Solute ko us ke alag alag hisson (ions ya molecules) mein todna (solute ka phailna).
Solute aur solvent ko aapas mein milne (interact karne) dena taa ke solution ban jaye.

blocks.text: Is process mein heat ya to nikalti hai ya jazb hoti hai. Ise bayan karne ke liye standard enthalpy change of solution istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Standard enthalpy of solution
blocks.text: Woh heat jo tab jazb ya kharij hoti hai jab kisi substance ka ek mole solvent mein ghul kar infinitely dilute (bohat hi patla) solution banaye.
Is ki alamat ΔH°sol hai aur yeh exothermic bhi ho sakti hai aur endothermic bhi. Sodium carbonate aur ammonium chloride ki enthalpy change of solution in equations se zahir hoti hai:

blocks.text_alt: Na₂CO₃(s) + aq → 2 Na⁺(aq) + CO₃²⁻(aq)    ΔH°sol = –25 kJ mol⁻¹
NH₄Cl(s) + aq → NH₄⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq)    ΔH°sol = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Table 6.2 mein kuch ionic solids ki pani mein infinite dilution par heats of solution di gai hain. Heat of solution ki miqdar se pata chalta hai ke solution banane wale hisson ke darmiyan kashish (attraction) ki forces kitni mazboot hain.

blocks.caption: Table 6.2 Heats of solution of some important ionic solids (kJ mol⁻¹)

blocks.text: Ionic compound mukhalif (opposite) charge wale ions se banta hai jo mazboot electrostatic forces se jure hote hain. Ghulne ka process do cheezon par depend karta hai:

items: Hydration energy (solute ke ions aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan kashish)
Lattice energy (ionic compound ko todne se mutaliq)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table 6.2 ki saari values musbat hain, yani yeh namak ghulte waqt thodi heat jazb karte hain aur pani thoda thanda ho jata hai. Na₂CO₃ ki value manfi hai, yani us ke ghulne par pani garam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Table 6.2 ke sab namak endothermic tareeqe se ghulte hain, phir bhi aasani se ghul jate hain. Kaun si do energies muqable mein hain, aur musbat heat of solution kya batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Lattice energy (ions ko alag karne ke liye deni parti hai) aur hydration energy (pani ke ions ko gherne par nikalti hai). Musbat heat of solution ka matlab hai ke lattice energy hydration energy se thodi zyada hai, is liye thodi heat mahol se li jati hai; namak phir bhi ghulte hain kyun ke ghulne se disorder (entropy) barhta hai.

items: Dissolution teen qadam: solvent phailna, solute tootna, dono ka milna.
ΔH°sol: ek mole substance ka infinitely dilute solution banna; exothermic (Na₂CO₃ –25) ya endothermic (NH₄Cl +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹).
Ghulna hydration energy aur lattice energy ke muqable se tay hota hai.
